body: I grow up while growing down What am I?
I had a bright start but I couldn't take the pressure. I consume everything, yet I don't eat anything. What am I?
I hatch without food What am I?
I have 4 eyes but cannot see. What am I?
I have a big mouth and I am also quite loud! I am not a gossip but I do get involved with everyone's dirty business?
I have a body of stone and a fiery heart and sooner or later my head and I will part. What am I?
I have a body, arms, legs and a head but have no heart nor no guts. What am I?
I have a brother. However much we run, we do not reach each other. What am I?
I have a face but no eyes and hands but no arms. What am I?
I have a face but no eyes, hands but no arms. What am I?
I have a face, two arms and two hands, yet I can not move. I count to twelve, yet I can not speak, I can still tell you something everyday?
I have a face, two arms and two hands, yet I can not move. I count to twelve, yet I can not speak. I can still tell you something everyday?
I have a face, yet no senses. But I don't really care, because time is of the essence?
I have a few points but we're not competing. I'll help you win when you're eating. What am I?
I have a foot but no legs. What am I?
I have a frame but n picture. I have poles but not standing up. What am I?
I have a frame but no pictures. I have poles but not standing up. What am I?
I have a gown but I'm not a priest; I have a crown but I'm not a king. What am I?
I have a head and a tail but my eyes can never see my tail. What am I?
I have a head and a tail, exactly the same size?
I have a head, tail but no arms and legs. What am I?
I have a heart of gold and I smell when I'm old. What am I?
I have a hole in my back and legs I lack. I live where I can’t breathe and I eat without teeth. What am I?
I have a hundred legs but cannot stand. I have a long neck but no head. I cannot see and I help keep your house neat and tidy. What am I?
I have a hundred legs but cannot stand. I have a long neck but no head. I cannot see. I'm neat and tidy as can be?
I have a large money box, 10 inches wide and 5 inches tall. Roughly how many coins can I place in my empty money box?
answer: Just one, after which it will no longer be empty.

body: I have a little house in which I live all alone. My house has no doors or windows and if I want to go out I must break through the wall. What am I?
I have a little pool with two layers of wall around it. One white and soft and the other dark and hard. Amidst a light brown grassy lawn with an outline of a green grass. What am I?
I have a little sister, they call her Peep, Peep; She wades the waters deep, deep, deep; She climbs the mountains high,high, high; Poor little creature she has but one eye?
I have a long tail that I let fly. Every time I go through a gap, I leave a bit of my tail in the trap. What am I?
I have a metal roof and glass wall. I burn and burn but never fall. what am I?
I have a mouth on my head and eat everything. What am I?
I have a name that's not mine and no one cares about me in their prime. People cry at my sight and lie by me all day and night. What am I?
I have a neck and no head, two arms but no hands. I'm with you to school, I'm with you to work. What am I?
I have a neck but no head. I have a body but no arm. I have a bottom but no leg?
I have a red cap on my head and a stone in my throat my sweetness is something of note. What am I?
I have a ring but no fingers. I used to stay still all the time but nowadays I follow you around. What am I?
I have a small hill with seven holes. What am I?
I have a straight back and sharp teeth to cut objects. What am I?
I have a tail and a head but no body. What am I?
I have a tail. I can fly. I'm covered in colorful feathers. I can whistle and I can talk?
I have a thousand needles but I do not sew. What am I?
I have a title and many pages. I am a genteel of genteel descent. I am a killer veteran of war. I am a slave to my lord pledged to his service?
I have a title and many pages. I am a genteel of genteel descent. I am a killer veteran of war. I am a slave to my lord pledged to his service. What am I?
I have an end but no beginning, a home but no family, a space without room. I never speak but there is no word I cannot make. What am I?
I have an eye But cannot see, You'll head inside When you see me?
I have an eye but cannot see. I am stronger and faster then any man alive but have no limbs?
I have an eye but cannot see. What I am?
I have arms but cannot carry a thing. But wave at me and I wave back at you. What am I?
I have been around for millions of year but I am never more than a month old?
